faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about BikinStiker
faq.a1: BikinStiker is an AI-powered app that lets you create custom stickers from text prompts. Describe what you want, and our AI generates unique stickers you can share anywhere.
faq.a2: BikinStiker has a free tier with 20 credits per month. We also offer Plus ($2.99/month) and Pro ($5.99/month) plans with more credits and premium features.
faq.a3: You earn credits by completing daily missions like sharing the app, generating stickers, and maintaining your streak. You can also earn bonus credits when friends use your referral link.
faq.a4: Yes! Your sticker packs are stored locally on your device, so you can access and use them even without an internet connection.
faq.a5: Your prompts and generated stickers are processed securely. We do not sell your personal data. See our Privacy Policy for full details.
faq.q6: How do I upgrade or cancel?
faq.a6: You can manage your subscription through the app or your app store account. Changes take effect at the end of your current billing period.
